name: Parth Shah
intro: I'm a Software Development Engineer 2 at Amazon, working on agentic systems and infrastructure. Right now I'm leading a cross-org effort to automate ticket investigation with AI agents, and building core pieces of World Catalog, Amazon's agent-first global catalog. Outside work, I co-created NAAMSE and HASHIRU, two open-source frameworks for AI red-teaming and budget-aware multi-agent orchestration. I studied Computer Science and Engineering at UC Davis.
credits: Built by Kunal Pai, Parth Shah and Harshil Patel.

wiki.tagline: From the personal encyclopedia of Parth Shah
summary: Parth Shah is a software engineer at Amazon, working on agentic AI systems and infrastructure. At Amazon, Shah leads a cross-org effort to automate ticket investigation with AI agents and worked on the seller contribution pipeline behind World Catalog.

Outside work, Shah co-created the open-source frameworks NAAMSE and HASHIRU, and built the decentralized inference engine behind Kiwi. Shah studied Computer Science and Engineering at the University of California, Davis.
